meta.origin: TreasuryDirect published savings-bond rates; fund SEC 30-day yields from issuer fact sheets; tokenized-treasury yields as advertised by their issuers
meta.note: Offline starting point, NOT a quote. Every savings bond, ticker, fund name, issuer and tokenized product named here is real, but the rate levels are approximate round figures for 2026-08-01 chosen to sit sensibly against that day's Treasury curve. Structural facts — effective duration, average credit quality, expense ratio, purchase limits, investor eligibility — live in the INSTRUMENTS table in src/sources/bonds.js, not in this file, because they are constants rather than quotes. Tokenized-fund AUM figures are order-of-magnitude only. Refresh to replace the fund and tokenized rows with measured values.

fields.key: matches an entry in the adapter INSTRUMENTS table, or the row is skipped
fields.yield: SEC 30-day yield for funds, advertised net yield for tokenized products, percent
fields.fixedRate: Series I fixed rate for the current issue window, percent, fixed for the life of the bond
fields.semiannualInflation: Series I semiannual inflation rate for the current window, percent (half the six-month CPI-U change)
fields.statedRate: Series EE announced coupon rate, percent — NOT the headline this adapter publishes
fields.resetOn: date the current savings-bond rate window began
